acceptance: make pr-preflight accepts HEAVY_ADMIT_WAIT with the heavy-run semantics, proven by a test that another process can take the lock during the wait.
Default behaviour without the variable is unchanged.
context: Filed 2026-11-24 from the close-out of the scale and TPC-DI remediation (umbrella remediation-revised-plan-20261120, done 2026-11-23).
description:
## Problem
`docs/agent/heavy-work.md` says: on `Error 76`, run the command again with `HEAVY_ADMIT_WAIT`, do not write a retry loop, and "only `make heavy-run` reads it". `make pr-preflight` is gated by the same admission but has no wait. On 2026-11-23 it was refused twice (exit 76, memory pressure level 2, swap 78%, receipt tree 74b8d037d6) while preparing #4463. The only way through was a hand-written retry loop, which the doc forbids; that session wrote one (disclosed here).

## Change
Make `make pr-preflight` honour `HEAVY_ADMIT_WAIT` with the semantics heavy-run-admission-wait-20261111 established: re-check every 60 s for 1 to 60 minutes, release the host lock between attempts, and keep the default (no wait) unchanged. Update heavy-work.md.

## Decision gates
- The default stays "no wait" unless the owner decides otherwise.
- The wait never sleeps while holding the host lock.

## Verification rubric
Pass: a test shows `make pr-preflight HEAVY_ADMIT_WAIT=<n>` re-checks admission, releases the lock between attempts (another process can take it meanwhile), and exits 76 after n minutes if never admitted; heavy-work.md names pr-preflight as reading the variable.

## Guardrails
- Work in a linked worktree from `make worktree-create`; never write in the primary clone. Stage named paths only; commit as the pinned human identity with no agent attribution.
- Push only after `make pr-preflight` passes on the exact head. Never `--no-verify`, force-push, or rewrite authorship.
- Arm only with `make pr-arm`, once per head. A second attempt only when the refusal named a cause that is now fixed; a third needs the owner. `make pr-rerun` only for a job the runner cancelled or never ran, never to re-roll a failed test.
- Never post a stand-in review. Resolve a review thread only after the bot has reviewed the new head and did not raise the finding again.
- Heavy work only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking target. Never set `BENCHBOX_HEAVY_ADMIT=force`, `BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK` or `BENCHBOX_HEAVY_WATCHDOG=off`.
- Any new limit, threshold, default or user-facing label is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- Do not mark a test skip, xfail, quarantine or slow to make it pass.
- Report only what merged and what was verified, with run ids and heads.
